item.title: American Legion Auxiliary Unit 23 hosts painting event at Barboursville Veterans Home
item.description: BARBOURSVILLE, W.Va. — Members of Point Pleasant’s American Legion Auxiliary Unit 23 recently traveled to the West Virginia Veterans Home in Barboursville to spend an afternoon painting alongside resident veterans, creating artwork, fellowship and meaningful moments of connection.

item.title: Main Street Point Pleasant represented at Hill Day in Washington D.C.
item.description: POINT PLEASANT, W.Va. — Chris Rizer, executive director of Main Street Point Pleasant, traveled to the nation’s capital last week to participate in Hill Day, an annual advocacy event organized by Main Street America.

item.title: The Friends of Gallia County's Animals seeks to expand impact in Gallia County
item.description: BIDWELL, Ohio — Friends of Gallia County’s Animals, a local nonprofit organization, is looking to broaden its reach and increase community involvement after more than a decade of serving the animal population in Gallia County.

item.title: Gallipolis City Commission tackles budget and infrastructure concerns in special session
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — The Gallipolis City Commission addressed the city’s proposed budget and heard pleas regarding deteriorating infrastructure during a special session held Tuesday evening at the Municipal Building.

item.title: Rio Grande Community College names Kristen Mershon director of Pike Center
item.description: PIKETON, Ohio — Rio Grande Community College has announced Kristen Mershon as the new director of its Pike Center. Mershon will continue serving in her current role as director of Rio’s Jackson Center, providing leadership at both regional locations and…

item.title: Rutland finance committee advances vehicle tax ordinances, recommends budget cuts for 2026
item.description: RUTLAND, Ohio — The Rutland Village Council Committee on Finance held its first hearing on three proposed ordinances that would increase the annual permissive tax for motor vehicle registrations, along with legislation adopting the village’s budget for fiscal year 2026.

item.title: Seabolt & Co. Modern Apothecary & Spa receives $10,000 Backing Small Businesses grant
item.description: POMEROY, Ohio — Seabolt & Co. Modern Apothecary & Spa has been awarded a $10,000 Backing Small Businesses Enhancement Grant from American Express and Main Street America.

item.title: Emancipation Scholarship applications now available in Gallia County
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — Gallia County Grants Administrator and Emancipation Days Committee Member Karen Sprague has confirmed that applications for the Emancipation Scholarships have been delivered to all the high schools in the county.

item.title: LaRose announces qualified candidates for May 5 Ohio primary ballot
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose announced on Thursday the list of partisan statewide candidates who met the minimum signature requirement to qualify for the May 5, 2026, primary election. Candidacies were subject to protest until Friday.
